mapper.select: SELECT ol.LineNumber AS LineNumber, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT a.AllocationId FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrderLineAllocations AS a WHERE a.CompanyId = ol.CompanyId AND a.OrderId = ol.OrderId AND a.LineNumber = ol.LineNumber) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsAllocated FROM {{schema}}.ShopOrderLines AS ol WHERE ol.Quantity > 1
